name: sample
description: A small plugin to read and copy: tasks from a folder of notes, a gate that looks for a word, a lane that says something.

inbox@1.description: One task for each markdown file in a folder: the first heading is the title, the rest is the body.

no-word@1.description: Fails when a file of the change's commit holds a word (FIXME unless "word" is set).

say@1.description: Prints what "say" holds. A lane type is any command: it passes when it exits 0.
